    if (!output || Object.keys(output).sort().join(",") !== "displacement,events,ownsMotion,sweep" || !Number.isFinite(output.displacement) || typeof output.ownsMotion !== "boolean" || !Array.isArray(output.events) || output.events.length > 2 || new Set(output.events).size !== output.events.length || output.events.some((event) => !["dash-start", "dash-end"].includes(event)) || !Array.isArray(output.sweep) || output.sweep.length > 64 || !output.sweep.every(Number.isFinite)) {
      throw new Error("Invalid transfer adapter output");
    }
    if (!output.ownsMotion && output.sweep.length) throw new Error("Inactive motion must not add collision sweep points");
    if (output.ownsMotion) {
      if (output.displacement === 0 && output.sweep.length) throw new Error("Zero displacement must not add sweep points");
      const points = [0, ...output.sweep, output.displacement];
      const direction = Math.sign(output.displacement);
      for (let index = 1; index < points.length; index++) {
        const gap = points[index] - points[index - 1];
        if (Math.abs(gap) > 1 + 1e-9 || direction !== 0 && Math.sign(gap) !== direction) throw new Error("Dash sweep must be monotonic with gaps of at most one recipient pixel");

  // remix:port
  function createMotionPort(adapter, recovered, config2) {

    const frozen = Object.freeze({ motion: Object.freeze(config2.motion), unitScale: config2.unitScale });
    function checkConfig(value) {
      if (!value || Object.keys(value).sort().join(",") !== Object.keys(frozen.motion).sort().join(",") || Object.keys(frozen.motion).some((key) => value[key] !== frozen.motion[key])) throw Error("Adapter changed frozen component configuration");

    const motion = Object.freeze({
      init(config3) {
        checkConfig(config3);
        initCalls++;
        coreState = recovered.init(config3);
        return coreState;
      },
      step(state2, input, config3) {
        checkConfig(config3);
        if (input.sourceBodyWidth !== 8) throw Error("Transfer changed verified source geometry");
        stepCalls++;
        const result = recovered.step(state2, input, config3);
        coreState = structuredClone(result.state);
        return result;
      }
    });
    const port = {
      reset(replay = false) {
        initCalls = stepCalls = 0;
        state = adapter.init(motion, frozen);
        if (initCalls !== 1) throw Error("Adapter must initialize the recovered component once");
        output = null;
        if (!replay) replayControls = [];
      },
      setDash(value) {
        dash = Boolean(value);
      },
      move(frame) {
        const down = window.isReplaying ? Boolean(replayControls[frame.tick]) : dash;
        if (!window.isReplaying) replayControls[frame.tick] = down;
        origin = frame.position;
        const before = stepCalls;
        const result = adapter.step(state, Object.freeze({ ...frame, dash: down }), motion, frozen);
        if (stepCalls !== before + 1 || initCalls !== 1) throw Error("Adapter must step the recovered component once per update");
        validateAdapterOutput(result.output);
        if (!result.output.ownsMotion && result.output.displacement !== frame.normalDisplacement) throw Error("Adapter changed ordinary recipient movement");
        state = result.state;
        output = structuredClone(result.output);
        return output;
      },
      paint(output2, glyph, y, facing) {
        if (!output2.ownsMotion || !output2.sweep.length) return;
        window.color("light_green");
        for (const offset of output2.sweep) window.char(glyph, origin + offset, y, { mirror: { x: facing } });
        window.color("green");
      },
      snapshot() {
        return { core: coreState, output, initCalls, stepCalls, dashHeld: dash };
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.code !== "KeyD") return;
      port.setDash(true);
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener("keyup", (event) => {
      if (event.code !== "KeyD") return;
      port.setDash(false);
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }, true);
    window.addEventListener("blur", () => port.setDash(false));
    window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
      if (config2.parentMessages === false) return;
      if (event.origin === location.origin && event.source === parent && event.data?.type === "dash") port.setDash(event.data.pressed);
    });
    return port;
  }

  // remix-frame.js
  var params = new URL(location.href).searchParams;
  var channel = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1)).get("channel");
  var config = { "motion": { "walkingSpeed": 2, "dashDistance": 60, "cooldownTicks": 25, "initialCooldownTicks": 10 }, "unitScale": 0.25, "parentMessages": false };
  if (params.get("test") === "1" && params.has("scale")) {
    const scale = Number(params.get("scale"));
    if (!Number.isFinite(scale) || scale <= 0 || scale > 2) throw Error("Invalid fixture scale");
    config.unitScale = scale;
  }
  window.motionPort = createMotionPort(adapter_exports, component_exports, config);
  window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
    if (event.source !== parent || !channel || event.data?.channel !== channel) return;
    if (event.data.type === "dash" && typeof event.data.pressed === "boolean") window.motionPort?.setDash(event.data.pressed);

  });
  window.onLoad();
  window.pakuReady = true;
  if (params.get("test") !== "1") window.gameClock.start();
  setInterval(() => {
    if (!channel) return;
    const state = window.pakuSnapshot();
    parent.postMessage({ type: "motion-status", channel, status: state.status, isReplaying: state.isReplaying, motion: state.motion }, "*");
  }, 80);
